title: Actuarial Analyst
summary: Uses maths, statistics and insurance data to estimate how much an insurer should hold for future claims (reserving) and charge for its products (pricing), while working through actuarial exams. Sits in the actuarial team of an insurer, reinsurer, consulting firm or global capability centre, under qualified actuaries.
dailyDuties: Prepare claims and premium data with SQL and Excel
Run reserving or pricing models and check the results
Analyse mortality, lapse or claims experience against assumptions
Update cash-flow or valuation models for quarterly reporting
Automate routine model runs with VBA, R or Python
Write short reports and notes for senior actuaries
Study for the next actuarial exam

skills.expectation: Estimate claims reserves and IBNR with standard reserving methods
Build and update pricing models for insurance products
Analyse mortality, morbidity, lapse or claims experience against assumptions
Fit distributions and models and judge whether results are credible
Build and check actuarial models and reports in Excel
Use Python or R to analyse data and automate actuarial work
Use Python or R to analyse data and automate actuarial work
Write clear reports and explain results to senior actuaries and clients
Pull policy, premium and claims data from databases
Know the basics of IFRS 17 and statutory valuation and reporting
Run or update cash-flow models in Prophet or a similar actuarial tool
Automate spreadsheets and model runs with VBA
Understand how treaties and retentions change results
Know IRDAI rules that affect reserving and pricing in India
Show results in clear charts and dashboards
